title: Express secret
intro: Share a confidential text (password, code, key) through a link that opens only once. The text is encrypted in your browser: the server never sees it in clear.
anonymous: No identification is asked. The recipient will be told that the content comes from an unverified third party.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.text: Your browser cannot encrypt a secret (cryptography unavailable). Use an up-to-date browser, with a secure connection.

text.label: Secret text
text.hint: {max} characters at most. It is encrypted before it leaves your browser.
text.required: Enter the text of the secret.
text.tooLong: The text is too long: {max} characters at most.
text.invalid: The text contains invalid characters: remove them or type it again.
text.counterOver: {count} characters of {max}: the text is too long.

duration.hint: After this delay, the secret is destroyed even if nobody read it.

error.sealFailed: The secret could not be encrypted in this browser. Try again with an up-to-date browser.
error.disabled: {entity} no longer offers express secrets. Your text was not sent.
error.rateLimited: Too many secrets created from your connection. Try again later: your text was not sent.
error.rateLimitedUntil: Too many secrets created from your connection. Try again from {time}: your text was not sent.
error.limitReached: Too many express secrets are waiting to be read on this service. Try again later: your text was not sent.
error.invalid: The service refused this secret. Reload the page and try again.

done.title: Secret created
done.announce: The secret has been created. Its link is shown only once.
done.shownOnce: This link is shown only once. Copy it now: it cannot be displayed again.
done.linkIsSecret: The link is the secret: it holds the key that decrypts the text. Whoever has it can read the secret.
done.selected: The link is selected: copy it with Ctrl+C (⌘+C on a Mac).
done.clipboard: The copied link can stay in the clipboard history of your device: clear it once you have passed the link on.
done.once: It can be read only once, then it is destroyed.
done.otherChannel: Pass the link on through another channel than the content it protects: for example, the password of an account by instant messaging and the account name by email.
